description: ONE transfer in full: both outlets, the employee, the invoice, the notes and the line items with quantities. Takes the transactionId AND the type exactly as get_stock_transfers returned them — the type decides which leg is read, and a wrong one fails. For send-transfer and receive-transfer this also returns the sibling leg, so you can name where the stock came from and where it is going, plus stockTransferId, which is what receive_stock_transfer needs. Line quantities are the amounts MOVED, recorded when the transfer was created — they are not current stock. Use get_stock for that.

type.description: The same type get_stock_transfers reported for that row
